text:
Maya: Quick thing — I'm iterating on a compact audit row for the console list (think: single-line change events). Want to include routing policy and quota handoff hints inline. Anyone see major UX or API pitfalls?
Trent: +1 on inline policy badges. Important to show which routing tier actually executed (gold/standard/fallback). Hover can show policy id + last applied timestamp.
Liam: Concern: pulling routing decision at render time could be expensive. We should surface the decision captured at event-time (store policy_snapshot) not compute live.
Maya: yes — storing snapshot sounds right. That implies export shape needs a small "policy_snapshot" blob. Anya, does that conflict with PII redaction rules?
Anya: It can if policy contains actor email or full tenant name. We should only store policy id, public label, and maybe a pseudonymized actor ref. No raw emails. Also add a redaction flag for exports.
AuditBot: Note: export schema v2 draft includes "policy_snapshot_id", "policy_label", and "actor_pseudonym". It also supports a "redaction_level" enum. See /internal/schemas/audit-v2.md
Courtney: UX thought — compact row should show 3 pillars: who, what, routing result. For quota handoff show a tiny token: "Q: 12/20" that expands to the quota policy + last reset. Avoid modal-heavy flows.
Trent: Agree. Add a tiny background color for fallback events (e.g., yellow). Also include an API endpoint to fetch full rendered context when team clicks: `/api/audit/{id}/context` — we should version that.
Liam: Implementation note: the API should return the precomputed render hints so console doesn't call compute-heavy services. Field: `render_hints.v1` with HTML-safe snippets or structured tokens.
Maya: Good. For rollouts: we need to support canarying the new compact row. Suggest a feature flag in console + telemetry event `audit.compact_row.visible` with `user_segment` and `policy_hit_rate`.
Anya: Telemetry also needs privacy-safe counts. Don't log actor identifiers in metrics. Use hashed actor bucket or tenancy-only aggregation.
Courtney: Also need a small dashboard card: "Audit UX health" — shows average click-to-context latency, rate of redacted exports, and percentage of events with policy_snapshot present.
Trent: Ops ask: add an alert when >1% of events lack a policy_snapshot for >5m. That usually indicates a pipeline regression.
Maya: Action items: 1) Liam to add `policy_snapshot` to write path + export schema draft, 2) Anya to propose redaction rules + sample pseudonymizer, 3) Courtney to mock compact row with quota chip and fallback color states, 4) Trent to spec `/api/audit/{id}/context` and alert.
Liam: I'll open a PR for the schemaupdate and a small migration plan (we can backfill last 30d).
Anya: I'll draft the redaction matrix and paste here.
Courtney: I'll add a Loom of the compact row interaction by EOD.
Maya: Thanks — tagging @Trent @Liam @Anya @Courtney to confirm. If no objections by tomorrow noon I'll start the rollout canary plan. :thumbsup:
AuditBot: Deploy notification: `audit-service` from branch `compact-ux` deployed to staging (build 7843)
Maya: Perf test note — once staging has data, run sampling to verify `render_hints` size stays <1KB on 95th percentile.
Liam: noted, will include in PR checklist.
